messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a close-up shot of the person's face from the front. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to a close-up shot of the person's face from the front. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character remains mostly still, facing the camera with subtle head movements and a consistent gentle smile.","camera":"A static, eye-level medium close-up shot that keeps the character centered in the frame.","clothing":"A bright pink, long-sleeved top with a square neckline and blue shoulder accents.","hair_color":"Blonde with brown buns.","hairstyle":"A short blonde bob with straight bangs, topped by two small brown buns on either side of her head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered young woman with a dark complexion, blue eyes, and a slight smile, shown from the chest up.","scene":"A futuristic, neon-lit environment at night, featuring a large glass dome structure with pink and blue glowing rings and a wet, reflective ground surface."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output is a static front-facing medium close-up of the character's face and upper chest, matching the reference framing. The character remains mostly still with subtle head movement and a gentle smile. The futuristic dome scene remains visible behind her, though the original walking motion and full-body framing are no longer shown.
arguments.requested_change: Change only the camera to a front-facing close-up of the person's face, using the reference for initial framing, while preserving appearance, expression, action, scene, timing, and progression.
uncertain: Whether the character's facial expression and identity were fully preserved from the source
Whether the scene background is the same location or a regenerated version
unexpected_changes: The source walking action was replaced by a mostly stationary pose
The original full-body side view was replaced by a chest-up front view
The character's clothing neckline appears different from the source, showing a square/off-shoulder neckline rather than the source's long-sleeved fitted top
